CloudOps
概览 AWS 次要 文件 配置包

源文件

.github/workflows/cloudops-validate.yml

离线配置。未部署到任何云账号。

# File-level workflow. It runs tools, check, and test. It does not deploy.
name: cloudops-validate
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: cloudops
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - name: tools
        run: make tools
      - name: check
        run: make check
      - name: test
        run: make test
